Name: Mind Whip
Description: You psychically lash out at one creature you can see within range, forcing them to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 3d6 psychic damage, and they can’t take a reaction until the end of their next turn. Moreover, on their next turn, they must choose whether they get movement, an action, or a bonus action (they get only one of the three). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the spell’s other effects.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The spell’s psychic damage increases by 1d6.
● You can target one additional creature. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
